summary: Iteration 4 — verified Firestore migration. Backend: 20/20 pytest pass against the public preview URL (https://sharp-mini-tools.preview.emergentagent.com). All API contracts preserved: product GET/PUT (incl. all 17+ new fields banner_text/ticker_text/trust_badges/reviews/faqs/fb_pixel_id/etc.), admin login (69ML@MT) / verify, orders create with phone<6→400 + address<3→400, list ordered by created_at DESC (verified via 2-order timing test), PATCH status (valid/invalid/unknown 404), DELETE (unknown 404), stats (total/revenue/status counts + 7-day daily array). Manual curl: 2 timestamped test orders created → list returned newer first → stats showed both, then both cleaned. Frontend E2E: landing renders from Firestore (banner, hero, 4 trust badges, 2 packages, reviews, FAQs), order placed via UI succeeded ('অর্ডার সফল হয়েছে!' toast), admin login at /admin/login redirected to /admin, dashboard reflected the new order (1 Total Orders, ৳550 Revenue, 1 Pending, recharts 7-day curve spike on today's date) — full integration with Firestore confirmed. Test order cleaned via DELETE API.

issues: Browser tab title is 'স্মার্ট পেন নাইফ — পকেটে রাখুন, প্রয়োজনে ব্যবহার করুন' (Smart Pen Knife) but the product is Magic Tissue. Static <title> in /app/frontend/public/index.html is stale from a previous template — should be updated to 'ম্যাজিক টিস্যু' or driven from product.site_name.
Admin UI still uses the old dark theme while public Landing uses the colorful light theme — same carry-over note from iter 2/3, not a regression of this migration.

React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — caused by Emergent dev-overlay wrapper injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option>. Cosmetic dev-only artifact, no production impact (same as iter 3).

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Update <title> in /app/frontend/public/index.html from 'স্মার্ট পেন নাইফ — পকেটে রাখুন, প্রয়োজনে ব্যবহার করুন' to 'ম্যাজিক টিস্যু'.

(Optional) Note that fb_pixel_id is None by default → window.fbq is intentionally not loaded on landing; if FB Pixel is wanted by default, seed a real fb_pixel_id. Not a regression — frontend code conditionally injects pixel only when fb_pixel_id is set.
(Optional cleanup) /app/backend/.env still has MONGO_URL and DB_NAME; backend no longer imports motor — safe to remove these unused keys, or keep for rollback parity.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses sync Firestore client wrapped in asyncio.to_thread() — correct pattern; consider switching to AsyncClient (google-cloud-firestore supports it) for native async if scale grows.
server.py still uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup') — migrate to lifespan handler.

_list_orders_sync() and _stats_sync() hard-cap at 1000 / 10000 docs — fine for MVP but should be paginated for production with growing orders collection. Stats also fetches every order doc to compute 7-day rollups; consider Firestore aggregation queries (count(), sum()) or precomputed counters for scale.
ProductUpdate strips None before set/merge — admin cannot clear a nullable field (e.g. offer_end_iso, fb_pixel_id) once populated. Same comment as iter 3.
Firestore creds path resolved via env var FIREBASE_CREDENTIALS_PATH with fallback — good. The secrets file is gitignored per request. Ensure prod deploy mounts it correctly.
ADMIN_TOKEN is a static string from env — adequate for single-admin MVP; for multi-admin / longer-term, rotate via JWT with expiry.
/app/frontend/public/index.html <title> is stale (Smart Pen Knife) — leftover from template.
